_note: Arrays are in SOURCE order: FY2026, FY2025, FY2024, FY2023, FY2022. INR million. Statements: stockanalysis.com standardised (S&P Global Market Intelligence), captured 26 Sep to 1 Oct 2026. Cross-checked against Yahoo Finance; Infosys and HCLTech translated from US dollars and checked against their rupee results. Prices: NSE close 25 Sep 2026.

industries.name: IT services
industries.note: Infosys and HCLTech publish their standardised statements in US dollars. They are translated into rupees, income and cash flow at each year's average rate and the balance sheet at the RBI year-end rate, then checked against their reported rupee results.

industries.name: Cement
industries.note: Ambuja and ACC are not included: their 15-month FY2023 makes the years incomparable.

industries.name: Tyres
industries.note: Only four listed tyre makers fit: MRF is excluded because its financial year ends in September.

industries.name: City gas distribution
industries.note: Only three fit: Gujarat Gas is excluded because its 2025 merger with GSPC and GSPL makes FY2025–26 incomparable with earlier years.

cos.name: Infosys Limited
cos.note: Operating cash flow is on the IFRS basis (interest received counts as operating), 2–5% above Infosys's Ind AS figure.

cos.name: Wipro Limited
cos.note: Wipro bought back 60 crore shares at ₹250 (₹15,000 crore) in June 2026. The share count is after the buyback, so enterprise value and the DCF take that cash off the March 2026 balance.
